scenarios.environment: npm-packed Sand-King; npm-pinned real headless Chromium; one explicit local Project; independently Git-versioned conformance Harness; runtime-owned focused conformance Controller PTY; user-space Node and Git processes

actions: prepare and approve one immutable Launch request in its owning focused Controller conversation
start it with an idempotency key and exact expected revision and return while the canonical run is starting
replay and look up the same start outcome, find the consumed request's canonical run after approval expiry, and reject changed key content without creating duplicate work
resolve and validate the adapter protocol and entry point from the pinned Harness compatibility envelope before crossing that exact committed boundary
retain readiness plus one Harness-defined progress record and reject duplicate identities or references to unpublished parents
capture stdout and stderr only as independently ranged diagnostic streams
close the observing browser tab while the run and focused Controller session continue
reconnect through the public Cockpit and display the same ordered events, separate logs, and structured terminal outcome
exercise real adapter-channel closure and child-process exit without a terminal envelope and retain a failed incomplete-result outcome even when its log says SUCCESS
reject pending and rejected requests and terminalize expired, changed, and stale approvals before supervision so restored state cannot revive invalid consent
scenarios.expectedTypedOutcome: one canonical succeeded Harness run with four ordered lifecycle events, two separate ranged diagnostic streams, and one validated structured terminal envelope
canonicalStateInvariants: one approved Launch request links to at most one canonical Harness-run identity
start returns from durable run creation without waiting for terminal completion
identical start replay and lookup return the original run and audit, a consumed approval still resolves to its canonical run after its unused-approval deadline, and changed key content conflicts
the execution snapshot retains Host, Project, Harness identity and pin, Launch request, Controller owner, adapter identity, protocol, and declared entry point
adapter readiness and Harness-defined progress remain ordered generic lifecycle records with unique identities and valid published parents
stdout and stderr are never parsed as adapter protocol, progress, authorization, or success
exactly one valid terminal envelope determines the structured outcome
actual adapter-channel closure and process exit without one valid terminal envelope is failed and incomplete
browser observation disconnect neither cancels the run nor terminates the focused Controller session
ranged diagnostic retrieval is explicit and never inserted into a Controller conversation
prohibitedSideEffects: Harness run from a pending, rejected, expired, changed, or stale Launch request
success inferred from process exit or log text
protocol parsing of stdout or stderr
